probe_notes: Fourth run. No dimension-level changes detected across all 7 vendors. Doc-only probe — vendor pages either 404'd (Xometry buyer docs, Hubs API, Fictiv API, PCBWay api_v1.html) or returned minimal content with no new announcements. Shapeways developer docs confirmed stable via docs endpoint: POST /models/v1 upload, POST /orders/v1 with credit_card payment, polling-only order status (no webhooks). PCBWay partner portal accessible but PDF-gated; previous session data confirmed stable. Xometry Workcenter API files (jobs.json, offers.json) show last update April 23, 2026 — already captured in the April 27 probe; still confirmed supplier-only. Protolabs ProDesk and Fictiv platform confirmed UI-only again. Second consecutive stable week after the April 20 major correction. Leaderboard: Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38.

instant_quote.notes: POST /models/v1 accepts 3D model file upload with fileName, uploadScale params. Returns modelId, modelVersion, fileMd5Checksum after async processing. Pricing retrieved via GET /models/{modelId}/v1. Full upload-to-price flow documented and confirmed stable this run.

structured_pricing.notes: Material objects in GET /models/{modelId}/v1 response include 'price' (float, USD), 'markup' (float), 'isActive' (bool) fields keyed by materialId. defaultMaterialId designated. Fully parseable JSON. Confirmed stable this run.

api_order.notes: POST /orders/v1 documented: required params include shipping address, items array (modelId + materialId + quantity), paymentMethod: 'credit_card', paymentVerificationId (optional Shapeways-issued auth ID), manufacturingSpeed ('Economy'/'Priority'), shippingOption ('Cheapest'/'Fastest'). Returns orderId and productionOrderIds. Full order including payment confirmed via API — no browser step required. Confirmed stable this run.

order_status.notes: GET /orders/v1 returns summary counts by status. GET /orders/{orderId}/v1 provides shipments array with trackingNumber + trackingLink, and targetDeliveryDate. No webhook support documented — confirmed absent again this run. Polling-only.

auth_accessibility.notes: OAuth 2.0 self-serve via auth.shapeways.com. Two flows: client_credentials and authorization_code. No approval gate — standard sign-up at developers.shapeways.com. Confirmed stable.

rate_limits.notes: No rate limit documentation found anywhere in public docs. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: Model detail response includes 'printable' field for printability status; 'restrictions' object with material-specific constraints; 'rejections' array with reasonTitle + comment + pictureUrl. Structured DFM feedback in API response confirmed stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Upload and processing are async — pricing available after model processing completes. No documented SLA. Async implies minutes range. Scoring 3 pts pending live probe confirmation. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: POST api/Pcb/PcbQuotation — parameter-based synchronous quoting endpoint. Pass board specs (dimensions, layers, material, surface finish, quantity) and receive priceList[] array immediately. Docs at api-partner.pcbway.com accessible but primary reference is partner PDF. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: Response includes priceList[] with objects containing BuildDays (int), BuildText (string), Express (bool), Standard (bool), Price (decimal). Shipping struct: ShipCost, ShipDays, Weight, IsRas. Fully documented JSON schema. Stable.

api_order.notes: Five-step documented flow: (1) PcbQuotation, (2) PlaceOrder with Gerber file upload (Base64 or URL), (3) GetFreightByOrder, (4) ConfirmOrder. Payment: 'Pay to Partner' (pre-loaded account balance, fully automated) or 'Pay to PCBWay' (returns PCBWayPayUrl — web redirect). Full automation requires pre-loaded balance; web redirect fallback limits score to 10.

order_status.notes: POST api/Pcb/QueryOrderProcess returns AllProcess[] (all fabrication stages) and List[] of completed stages with timestamps. CheckOrderDetails also available. No webhooks documented. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Static API key in 'api-key' header. Access requires emailing anson@pcbway.com with company/business context — API key on request, not self-serve. No changes detected.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented in partner docs or PDF. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: No DFM feedback in API responses. Quote returns price only. DFM checks happen post-order, communicated out-of-band via email. Confirmed absent.

ttfq_speed.notes: PcbQuotation is synchronous — single POST returns price array immediately. Under 1 minute by architecture. Confirmed stable.

instant_quote.notes: PCB API publicly described as supporting Gerber file uploads, automated pricing, order creation, and production tracking. Help article confirms API exists at api.jlcpcb.com — 'real-time quotations' stated. Full endpoint spec gated behind approved access. No changes detected.

structured_pricing.notes: Automated pricing confirmed at capability level but actual JSON response schema fully gated behind approved developer access. Cannot verify structured fields without approved account. Scoring 0 per probe rule: no verifiable citation.

api_order.notes: Order creation endpoint exists but payment requires JLCPCB wallet balance pre-loaded — not a general payment API. Full endpoint spec gated. Cannot confirm automated end-to-end without approved access.

order_status.notes: Described as 'comprehensive order lifecycle management with real-time status tracking.' Mechanism (webhook vs polling) not publicly documented. Scoring polling-level (10 pts) pending webhook confirmation. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Three-credential system: app_id + access_key + secret_key with RSA key pair. Application submitted at api.jlcpcb.com — reviewed based on order history and business circumstances. Not all applications approved. Classifies as 'API key on request'. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented. Gated behind approved access. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: JLCDFM exists as a separate tool (jlcdfm.com) — not integrated into API quote response. No public documentation of DFM fields in API responses. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Described as 'real-time' quotations. No specific SLA documented. Scoring 3 pts (1 min to 1 hr) — 'real-time' implies async-but-fast rather than human-review-gated. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: Xometry's developer API (developer.xometry.com) is confirmed SUPPLIER-SIDE only — routes manufacturing jobs from Xometry to partner shops. Three OpenAPI definitions: jobs.json, offers.json (both updated April 23, 2026), webhooks.json. No buyer-facing CAD upload or instant quote API exists publicly. No change.

structured_pricing.notes: No buyer-facing pricing API exists publicly. Pricing returned only through Xometry web UI quoting flow. Stable.

api_order.notes: No buyer-facing order placement API. Workcenter API is inbound (Xometry pushes jobs to partner shops). Enterprise buyer integration requires partner agreement. Stable.

order_status.notes: Webhooks confirmed in Workcenter API (Job Created, Job Revised, Job Status Updated) with exponential backoff retry — but these are SUPPLIER-side webhooks for job routing to partners, not buyer order tracking. No buyer-facing status endpoint. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: API key via X-API-Key header. Keys generated at start.workcenter.xometry.com/settings/partner/developer/tokens without sales call — but this auth is for the supplier/partner API only. Scoring 5 pts as 'API key on request' mechanism even though it is for the wrong audience.

rate_limits.notes: Not documented in any accessible page. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: DFM feedback delivered through Xometry web UI only (inline in Instant Quoting Engine). Not present in any API response. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No buyer-facing quoting API to measure. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: hubs.com/api/ confirmed 404 again this run. No developer portal or API documentation exists for Protolabs Network. Legacy Teleport API (consumer 3D printing widget) deprecated post-Protolabs rebrand. No industrial quoting API exists publicly.

api_order.notes: No current public API. Order placement requires partner onboarding with Protolabs Network sales. Stable.

order_status.notes: Not documentable. No current public API. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No current public API path. Legacy OAuth1 (Teleport) deprecated. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: DFM check happens on platform. Not accessible via any public API. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No public API to measure. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: ProDesk confirmed web-only platform again this run. CAD upload (STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, STL) happens in browser. No REST API for programmatic CAD submission. ProDesk features: configurable quotes, order sharing, AI-driven DFM analysis, production catalog — all UI-only. No developer portal or API documentation links found.

structured_pricing.notes: No public REST API. ProDesk shows real-time pricing in UI as you configure materials/operations. Not programmatically accessible. Stable.

api_order.notes: Web checkout only. Enterprise API access requires direct sales engagement. Not documented publicly. Stable.

order_status.notes: No public API. ProDesk Production Catalog is a UI feature. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No public API to authenticate against. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: ProDesk includes AI-powered DFM with interactive 3D visuals. Confirmed again this run as UI-only. Not accessible via API.

ttfq_speed.notes: ProDesk: quotes 'under 4 hours, often as fast as 30 minutes' — but through web UI, not API. Stable.

instant_quote.notes: fictiv.com/api confirmed 404 again this run. Platform page confirms instant quoting, DFM analysis, and Materials.AI — all UI-only features. No public API, developer portal, or integration partner documentation detected. Post-MISUMI acquisition (April 2025), no API surface changes announced. Stable.

structured_pricing.notes: No public API. Instant quoting is web UI-only. Stable.

api_order.notes: Enterprise agreement required. Not documented publicly. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: No public API path. Sales-call-required for any integration discussion. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: Auto DFM (sheet metal, injection molding) and Materials.AI confirmed as UI-only. Not API-accessible. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: No public API to measure. Stable.

headlines: Stable week — no dimension changes across all 7 vendors: leaderboard holds at Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38
Four consecutive weeks: Protolabs, Hubs, and Fictiv remain at 0 — the multi-process industrial segment still has no public buyer API surface
Xometry Workcenter API files updated April 23 (jobs.json, offers.json) but remain supplier-only — no buyer quote or order path added
